description.value:
Do you remember waiting outside a toy store, hoping for your first BB gun? Of course not, those were wiped out 90 years ago. But Budget Arms does, and they’ve decided to revamp the concept of a kid-friendly air gun. This amped-up toy uses C02 cartridges that propel metal ball bearings at speeds comparable to modern pistols, and without any of those nasty exothermic reactions!

Cost: 25eb (Costly)

Class: Exotic PQ Very Heavy Pistol

Skill: Handgun • Range: Snubnose Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Pistol Snub Barrel • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon can only load proprietary ammunition (10eb per 2 rounds), which does not ablate armor and cannot cause Critical Injuries. When firing this weapon, the user may choose to expend an additional bullet to deal 1d6 additional damage (5d6).

Range: Snubnose Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Snub Barrel (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
